etymology: From the orchard: you pick the fruit that looks best and leave the rest on the tree for someone else to find.
committed_when: There is a large body of evidence and a conclusion to support.
tell: Each cited fact checks out; the pattern only holds because of what is missing.
counter: Ask for the denominator: the same measure over the same period, including the years that argue the other way.
senses: Selecting the evidence that supports a conclusion while ignoring the evidence that does not.
It works because every selection is individually true. Nothing in the sentence is a lie, so the audit has to ask what was left out - and the audience rarely sees the tree.
example: *“Crime fell in the years we cut the programme.”* It also fell in the four years before, in the neighbouring county, and by more.

confused_with.tell: Cherry picking removes the inconvenient data; the sharpshooter keeps all of it and moves the target instead.
